trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial (research contract exploratory extension), designed live in S on 2026-09-30 using the shared skeleton. Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. No stress or out-of-bound rounds. Items (invented, away from canon): F1 = Professor Wilderberry brings a remedy for Aragog on Thursday at four o'clock (told by Harry, R1); F2 = the remedy has to be kept in the blue jar on the top shelf (told by Harry, R2); C1 = what Hagrid put in the rock cakes, stated in his own words in R3 (in the design run: flour and sugar, plus 'a bit o' this an' that'). Rounds and expected answers: R1 establish F1; R2 establish F2; R3 elicit C1; R4 recall F1, neutral, distance 3, expected Professor Wilderberry + Thursday + four o'clock; R5 control, neutral, supplied location, expected Hagrid's hut; R6 self-contradiction probe on C1, distance 3, exclusive misquote ('the only things … are flour and dried fish') that keeps flour and replaces the rest, because his 'this an' that' would let any added ingredient be accepted without contradiction; expected the NPC rejects it and restates its own R3 ingredients (correctness is relative to the NPC's R3 answer in the same run); R7 recall F1, distance 6; R8 misquote probe on F2, distance 6, changes only the colour (blue to red) with the same remedy and shelf, expected the NPC rejects 'red' and restates blue; R9 recall F2, neutral, persistence check after R8, expected the blue jar on the top shelf; R10 recall F1, distance 9, expected Professor Wilderberry + Thursday + four o'clock.
